## File: facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdparty/github/fairinternal/postman/third_party/grpc/third_party/protobuf/third_party/benchmark/mingw.py

Prompts

```
['download a specific version of MinGW compiler for a given architecture and threading model', 'parse the mingw-builds repository files to get available compiler versions and download URLs', 'unpack a mingw-builds archive using 7zip to a specified location on disk', 'locate the 7zip executable on the system by searching PATH or Windows registry', 'get the root folder of a specific MinGW compiler variant, downloading it if not cached']
```

Usage

```
{'download_mingw': 'download a specific version of MinGW compiler for a given architecture and threading model', 'repository_parse': 'parse the mingw-builds repository files to get available compiler versions and download URLs', 'unpack_archive': 'unpack a mingw-builds archive using 7zip to a specified location on disk', 'find_7zip': 'locate the 7zip executable on the system by searching PATH or Windows registry', 'root_get_compiler': 'get the root folder of a specific MinGW compiler variant, downloading it if not cached'}
```
